Status.note: An Entergy blog post of May 19, 2026 (https://www.entergy.com/blog/delta-blues-reaches-important-milestone-in-construction) says the heat recovery steam generator modules are being erected. POWER Magazine reported a groundbreaking on November 7, 2024 (https://www.powermag.com/entergy-mississippi-breaks-ground-on-754-mw-gas-fired-power-station/). So the unit is under construction. The EIA table for September 2026 still says regulatory approvals pending, which looks out of date. This is the same status GEM already shows.

Start year.note: Entergy Mississippi's project page (https://www.entergymississippi.com/generation/deltablues) says construction is expected to finish by 2028. The EIA table for September 2026 gives a planned operating date of May 2028. GEM's 2028 is right.

units.notes: The unit is moving, so Latest Activity is left alone. I found no new owner, operator or turbine information beyond what GEM has. The air permit lists 773 MW and the EIA table lists 477 plus 341.7 MW, but Entergy's 754 MW stays as the headline figure.

qa.recommendation: The construction step is best dated to November 2024. Entergy Mississippi held a groundbreaking on November 7, 2024, which POWER Magazine reported on November 8, 2024. The Mississippi air construction permit was issued later, on April 16, 2025.
